not_runtime_schema: This is a proposal registry, not an asset accepted by the current runtime compiler.

cards.owner_scope: resolved adult appeal intent and declared scene
cards.proposition_en: The authored scene resolves attraction, private familiarity, and perceived danger separately; concrete carriers realize only the meaning actually selected.
cards.implementation_note_ko: 원래 연령 미확인 S09는 관찰 자료로 유지한다. 추상 의도는 형태 원자가 아니며 현행 sensual/fetish controls의 뜻과 값을 변경하지 않는다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.owner_scope: declared garment on the same subject
cards.proposition_en: A fitted garment follows the declared torso contour; waist shaping belongs to its seams and outer boundary while the wearer's prescribed body proportions remain intact.
visual_components: seams or tension folds on that garment
cards.implementation_note_ko: 기존 fitted/opaque/skimming 후보의 효과 범위를 비교한다. 핏·체형·노출을 같은 효과로 확장하지 않는다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.owner_scope: one selected dress and one continuous leg
cards.proposition_en: Two finished edges form a side opening in the same dress; the selected leg is visible through that opening while the dress's remaining panel and hem remain continuous.
confusion_boundaries: a torn panel instead of a constructed slit
generic China dress forced into a canonical qipao
cards.implementation_note_ko: 재사용 기존 pfe_slit. 민소매·차이나 드레스만으로 칼라·사선 여밈·전통 판본 전체를 추가하지 않는다. 높이는 원 요청의 부위 관계로 묶는다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.owner_scope: selected vest or bodice panel
cards.proposition_en: Curved vertical seams divide a fitted vest's torso panels and remain visibly joined to those panels; a seam pattern alone does not introduce lacing, boning, underwear, or restraint.
confusion_boundaries: bra cup seams replacing torso panels
cards.implementation_note_ko: 기존 layered corset/bustier 후보는 다른 의복·효과일 수 있다. 단순 동의어 추가 전에 새 garment_detail 원자로 비교한다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.owner_scope: declared garment region and hidden construction
cards.proposition_en: Visible garment volume may be described at a named region, but a concealed integrated pad is an authored construction premise rather than a pixel-observable internal structure.
visual_components: visible pad boundary only if naturally exposed
confusion_boundaries: claiming a hidden pad passed pixel inspection
cards.implementation_note_ko: 안 보이는 패드를 검증하기 위해 의상을 벗기거나 절개하지 않는다. 내부 제작 조건과 겉 실루엣의 증거를 분리한다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.owner_scope: selected garment surface
cards.proposition_en: The selected black garment retains continuous edges and local reflective bands that curve with its folds; fit, base color, and specular response are separate owned properties.
visual_components: dark base planes retaining material detail
confusion_boundaries: black acrylic furniture instead of clothing
global bloom instead of surface sheen
latex as an automatic sexual role
cards.implementation_note_ko: 현행 latex/leather 혼합 프로필의 전제·추가 여밈 요구를 확인한다. 재료 원자만 필요한 요청에 새 여밈이나 fetish 문맥을 필수로 넣지 않는다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.owner_scope: two declared garment or armor surfaces
cards.proposition_en: The declared leather-like panel has restrained surface sheen, while its adjacent metal ornament has separately bounded reflections and visible localized wear.
confusion_boundaries: all surfaces with the same gloss
cards.implementation_note_ko: leather-like는 외관 비교로 유지한다. 피부·머리 청결을 바꾸지 않고 장식 금속의 마모만 지정한다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.owner_scope: same satin-like garment
cards.proposition_en: A continuous satin-like garment carries broad smooth luster along its fold curvature while seams and darker planes retain surface continuity.
confusion_boundaries: silk as a synonym of every satin
wet skin shine replacing fabric luster
cards.implementation_note_ko: 이미 충분한 기존 의미를 재사용한다. satin/ silk 병기 표현은 섬유와 직조의 두 축으로 연구표에서 분해하되 원문을 고치지 않는다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.owner_scope: lace band and separate base garment
cards.proposition_en: A narrow openwork lace band is attached along an edge of the base garment, with a readable join and a distinct free edge.
cards.implementation_note_ko: 기존 프로필의 원자·gate를 보존한다. 불투명 바탕은 원래 선택된 후보가 요구할 때만 적용하며 일반 lace trim의 새 기본값으로 만들지 않는다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.owner_scope: adult subject, neckline edge and selected body region
cards.proposition_en: The declared neckline edge has a readable shape and depth relative to the torso; the requested visible body region is continuous with that edge.
cards.implementation_note_ko: decolletage와 cleavage 기존 프로필의 의미 차이를 유지한다. square/low/cleavage를 하나의 alias로 묶지 않고 성인 문맥과 요청 부위를 각각 확인한다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.owner_scope: selected dress strap
cards.proposition_en: A narrow shoulder strap runs continuously from the selected garment front over the shoulder to its declared rear attachment.
confusion_boundaries: bag strap instead of garment strap
cards.implementation_note_ko: spaghetti/thin strap은 폭 축이다. 비대칭 흘러내림·오프숄더·목걸이와 분리한다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.owner_scope: one garment-owned strap and its shoulder
cards.proposition_en: One attached shoulder strap lies below its own shoulder crest; its front and rear garment connections remain traceable while the opposite side keeps its independently declared state.
cards.implementation_note_ko: 설계된 one-shoulder와 상태 변형을 구별하는 별도 관계 후보 trial. 정지 프레임에서 실제 흘러내린 시간·원인은 입증하지 않는다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.owner_scope: selected slip-like garment system
cards.proposition_en: A slip-like dress is represented through its selected straps, drape, and trim; actual undergarment use, outerwear layering, and erotic intent remain separately resolved context.
confusion_boundaries: adding a tee or lining by default
cards.implementation_note_ko: 기존 underwear-as-outerwear는 레이어가 요청된 경우에만 선택한다. 일반 슬립 의상에 새 가림/노출 조건을 덧붙이지 않는다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.owner_scope: declared cloth region
cards.proposition_en: Moisture belongs to one bounded cloth region; sheen and selected partial transmission are represented independently while the same fabric's edges remain continuous.
confusion_boundaries: dry sheer cloth as proof of wetness
cards.implementation_note_ko: wet 상태만으로 transparency 후보를 채택하지 않는다. 젖음과 투과를 결합한 원문에서는 두 속성을 각각 bind한다. 실제 직물 투과율·젖음의 인과는 미검증.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.owner_scope: selected garment and same subject region
cards.proposition_en: The selected garment adheres locally to its declared body region; nearby cloth tension and folds connect that contact to traceable garment edges.
cards.implementation_note_ko: 기존 static-cling은 원인·문맥이 다를 수 있다. 밀착·젖음·투과를 별도로 선택하고 몸 자체의 비율을 바꾸지 않는다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.owner_scope: same subject hair and face or neck
cards.proposition_en: Damp hair forms traceable strand bundles with local adherence to the declared skin region; roots and the contact path stay visible.
cards.implementation_note_ko: 기존 wet_damp 프로필과 접촉 후보를 재사용. 과거 샤워 사실이나 인물의 성적 상태를 뜻으로 추가하지 않는다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.owner_scope: selected visible skin patch
cards.proposition_en: Discrete droplets or bounded moisture on a selected skin patch carry light-consistent highlights without transferring that wetness to neighboring fabric or the whole body.
confusion_boundaries: whole-body wetness inferred from one spot
cards.implementation_note_ko: 피부 물기·뷰티 메이크업·장면 광택을 분리한다. 원래 청결 조건이나 의복 상태를 덮지 않는다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.owner_scope: mirror or glass surface and visible room
cards.proposition_en: Condensation and discrete droplets occupy the mirror plane; visible reflection remains continuous in the unoccluded region while moisture does not migrate to the lens or the reflected person.
confusion_boundaries: wet hair as proof of a completed shower
cards.implementation_note_ko: just-out-of-shower는 상황 해석이며 시간 증거가 아니다. mirror plane/카메라 렌즈/공기 안개를 따로 기록한다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.owner_scope: selected glove on one arm
cards.proposition_en: The glove continuously covers the selected hand and forearm; its upper edge sits above the same arm's elbow with the declared gloss.
confusion_boundaries: long sleeve mistaken for a glove
black glove as aggression or fetish intent
cards.implementation_note_ko: above the elbows를 독립 mood 대신 소유된 길이 관계로 묶고 좌우 장갑 상태를 혼동하지 않는다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.owner_scope: neck band, front ornament and neck armor as separately selected objects
cards.proposition_en: A close neck band retains a continuous fastening path; a selected front ring attaches to that band and remains distinct from any separately chosen protective neck piece.
cards.implementation_note_ko: 검정 밴드·금속 링·neck armor의 원자 조합. 장식 착용만으로 실제 움직임 제한이나 성적 역할을 추가하지 않는다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.owner_scope: declared garment attachments and hanging chain
cards.proposition_en: A narrow strap connects at declared garment points; the decorative chain hangs between or from its own attachment points with a coherent downward curve.
cards.implementation_note_ko: 가방·라펠 전용 기존 관계를 일반 의상에 바로 동의어 확장하지 않는다. 다른 owner면 새 variant가 필요하다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.title_ko: 부분 보호 장식과 실제 보호 기능
cards.owner_scope: selected ornament or armor patch
cards.proposition_en: A bounded protective-looking ornament overlaps only the declared garment or body region; unobserved protective performance remains outside the visual claim.
confusion_boundaries: complete armor added from one patch
extra straps invented to force fit
cards.implementation_note_ko: 부분적 의상 장식과 완전 armor-system의 필수 구조를 구별한다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.owner_scope: same subject tie and shirt collar
cards.proposition_en: The selected leather-like tie knot sits below its collar reference with a traceable loop and a gravity-following hanging blade.
cards.implementation_note_ko: 격식의 느슨함은 창작 해석이다. 끈의 해부학적 연결을 구체화하고 목을 제한하는 뜻으로 바꾸지 않는다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.owner_scope: one body and its supporting bedding
cards.proposition_en: The reclining subject has readable torso and limb support; the bedding depresses at the same contact region and adjacent folds respond locally to that load.
confusion_boundaries: bed dent away from the body
cards.implementation_note_ko: 원래 relaxed limb 위치를 유지한다. 침구 패턴/장식 대신 접촉 부위와 국소 변형을 보강하며 체중 수치·실제 수면 상태를 추정하지 않는다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.owner_scope: subject, mirror plane and sink if present
cards.proposition_en: The subject's visible gaze is directed toward their reflected face; the mirror plane and reflection align with the body's actual position beside the declared sink.
confusion_boundaries: camera gaze substituting for mirror gaze
adding a sink to an unrelated portrait
cards.implementation_note_ko: 기존 건축 유리 프로필은 반사면 근거일 뿐 인물 reflection 의무를 자동 충족하지 않는다. 새 directed gaze 관계를 부분 trial.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.title_ko: 손으로 젖은 머리를 쓸어 넘기는 접촉
cards.owner_scope: same subject hand and hair
cards.proposition_en: The raised hand reaches the subject's own damp hair; fingertips and strand bundles share a visible contact region while arm continuity and torso balance remain intact.
confusion_boundaries: hand near hair without required contact
cards.implementation_note_ko: 일반 hand-in-hair와 실제 접촉 선택을 구별한다. 근처/통과/정리 중 표현의 확정 의미는 original context로 결정한다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.owner_scope: declared kneeling actor and hand targets
cards.proposition_en: The selected kneeling configuration keeps knees, feet and pelvis support readable; the declared palms face upward and hold a selected cupped shape without an invented coercing actor.
confusion_boundaries: new controller or deity added from the pose
prayer label as proof of personal belief
cards.implementation_note_ko: 자세 geometry 재사용. 원문 기도·봉헌은 관계/상황으로 보존하며 새로운 종교 도상이나 성적 역할을 기본으로 만들지 않는다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.owner_scope: one subject face and declared gaze target
cards.proposition_en: Visible eyelid aperture and pupil direction are recorded on the same face; a calm or dreamy reading is contextual authoring intent rather than proof of a unique internal state.
cards.implementation_note_ko: 기존 세부 표정 프로필의 geometry를 조합하되 감정어를 hard morphology의 동의어로 넣지 않는다. 잠들기 전·우연성은 순간 서사다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.owner_scope: same face upper and lower lip
cards.proposition_en: The upper and lower lips remain near each other with a small visible central gap; jaw opening and lip shape retain the requested expression.
confusion_boundaries: unscaled pixel gap certified as 1–2 mm
cards.implementation_note_ko: 닫힌 lip_press/lip_tighten을 선택해 열린 입술을 대체하지 않는다. 1–2mm는 original authored scale intent이며 참조 눈금 없는 사진에서 mm PASS 판정하지 않는다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.owner_scope: declared camera and subject; POV body only if given
cards.proposition_en: A first-person camera occupies its declared height beside the support surface and looks upward toward the subject; relative height does not itself introduce body contact or control.
visual_components: declared POV body region when necessary
confusion_boundaries: POV without a declared body interpreted as chest contact
cards.implementation_note_ko: floor/stone reference와camera방향을 분리해 owner bind. 원문 제압의 별도 contact 의미는 VEL-041에서 다룬다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.owner_scope: frame, focus planes and required evidence owners
cards.proposition_en: The selected face remains in focus while each independently required contact or garment boundary is readable at its own depth; shallow depth is a selected treatment rather than permission to erase required evidence.
confusion_boundaries: sharp face but hidden required contact
numerical aperture as proof of focus
changing requester blur to satisfy a test
cards.implementation_note_ko: 시각 의무 all-of 조합을 검토. 사용자가 의도한 가림·흐림은 보존하고 그 관계는 UNOBSERVABLE로 남긴다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.owner_scope: declared carrier and separately counted equipment
cards.proposition_en: Each declared weapon remains one continuous object with its own carrier or mounting; tactical footwear and armor retain separate object identities without proving an attack.
cards.implementation_note_ko: 총잡이·전술 소재는 역할/외형이다. 관측된 원문 장비와 공격 행동을 분리하고 실제 작동·전술 방법의 데이터로 확장하지 않는다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.owner_scope: one sidearm and its worn holster
cards.proposition_en: One sidearm is seated in its visible holster attached to the declared carrier; it is not simultaneously held in a hand or directed at a target.
confusion_boundaries: held weapon substituted for holstered state
cards.implementation_note_ko: 기존 재질/형태 후보 재사용. no aiming 표현을 자동 semantic negative로 넣는 대신 선택 상태와 frozen meaning 충돌 검증으로 처리한다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.owner_scope: declared hand, weapon and sheath if selected
cards.proposition_en: The selected held object has a readable hand contact and continuous geometry; a partial draw retains the same object partly inside its declared sheath while dual holding keeps two distinct hand-object pairings.
confusion_boundaries: drawing a picture as weapon drawing
two hands holding one object instead of two objects
fully exposed object replacing partial draw
cards.implementation_note_ko: 범용 held/sheathed/transitional-contact contract를 우선 활용한다. 화기 작동법·검술 순서를 설계하지 않고 프레임에서 보이는 상태만 모델링한다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.owner_scope: declared actor, carried prop and target if specified
cards.proposition_en: The declared prop's orientation is directed toward its specified target or off-frame direction; actor support and the prop's held contact remain readable without introducing a discharge or injury.
cards.implementation_note_ko: 준비·자세·조준을 서로 다른 상태로 둔다. off-frame 대상은 새 인물로 채우지 않는다. 연령·피해 정도·무기 종류는 원 요청 소유다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.title_ko: 재장전 등 시간 동사의 정지 증거
cards.owner_scope: declared prop and its visible state
cards.proposition_en: A named temporal action is supported only by its authored present-frame hand-object configuration; duration, mechanical cycle completion and unseen operations require separate temporal evidence.
confusion_boundaries: a completed process inferred from holding
arbitrary mechanism added for a verb
cards.implementation_note_ko: 원문 동사는 보존하되 공개 후보에 조작 순서/구동 레시피를 만들지 않는다. 새 의미 동의어 이전에 구체적 요청 문맥을 확보하는 hold.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.title_ko: 등 뒤 기계 무장의 장착 소유
cards.owner_scope: fictional mounted equipment and carrier
cards.proposition_en: A fictional back-mounted unit connects to its declared carrier through a readable mount; the unit's silhouette and the human body's support remain separately traceable.
confusion_boundaries: real weapon engineering inferred from fictional shape
cards.implementation_note_ko: 미래형·기계식은 허구 외형의 한정 variant이다. 몸을 장비 부품으로 바꾸거나 유혈을 수반하는 새 행동을 추가하지 않는다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.owner_scope: declared fictional actors, effect origin and barrier
cards.proposition_en: A fictional effect has a visible declared origin, a directed path and a localized encounter with the selected barrier; defensive actor and casting actor retain distinct roles if both are present.
confusion_boundaries: floating glow with no origin or target
outstretched arm as proof of casting
cards.implementation_note_ko: 판타지 효과는 창작 설계이며 물리 현상의 과학적 정의가 아니다. 한 팔 확장과 실제 시전은 같은 alias로 묶지 않는다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.owner_scope: effect contact zone and separate material fragments
cards.proposition_en: Light sparks and material fragments occupy a bounded encounter region; each selected fragment remains distinct from the figure's body and from global image-plane grain.
confusion_boundaries: body parts instead of stone debris
cards.implementation_note_ko: 반짝이는 입자·암석 파편·피부 피해의 owner를 분리한다. 사건 인과는 작성된 허구 상황의 의미이며 실제 발생 증명으로 보고하지 않는다.
cards.adoption_policy: optional_postcore; no broad-label hard activation; preserve frozen request/core and existing selected obligations

cards.owner_scope: same actor and attached cloak
cards.proposition_en: The actor's cloak remains attached to its declared collar or shoulder points; trailing folds extend behind that actor with a coherent present pose.
confusion_boundaries: wind direction treated as universal parallelism
robe motion as injury or attack
cards.implementation_note_ko: 의복 움직임을 바람·회전·질주 등 하나의 자동 원인에 묶지 않는다. 선택된 장면의 cause와 부착 토폴로지를 함께 검토한다.

cards.implementation_note_ko: S15의 학생 맥락은 비성적 분석으로만 유지한다. adult-assault 프로필은 성인·원치 않는 힘·결과의 추가 전제를 가져 자동 재사용하지 않는다. 압력의 크기나 원치 않음은 픽셀만으로 인증하지 않는다.

confusion_boundaries: ruin as proof of a recent fight

cards.implementation_note_ko: 전투 직후는 source 서사이고 흔적은 현재 관찰 축이다. 파손 owner·손상 정도·인물 청결을 별도로 bind. 새 혈흔은 추가하지 않는다.

cards.implementation_note_ko: 완료·천천히는 시간 전제다. 현재 물건 상태와 손 접촉을 구체화하고 사건 결과를 확대하지 않는다.

cards.implementation_note_ko: 기존 wrap 원자 재사용. 치료/패션/상징 문맥은 서로 equivalent paraphrase로 등록하지 않는다.

cards.implementation_note_ko: K152의 worn/damaged는 owner가 선행해야 한다. K152는 S11 설명문의 비성적 피해 맥락에 있고, 의복 파편 사례는 참조 대화 6절의 별도 본문 보충 사례이다. 후자는 원본 JSON의 19 source ID에 대응 근거가 없어 새 ID나 나이를 발명하지 않으며 성적 variant의 씨앗으로 사용하지 않는다.
